source_title: Xbox Game Pass Gets 4 New Titles in Big October 2026 Release Wave
source_excerpt:
An October 29 update to the Xbox Game Pass library has introduced four new titles. The arrivals mark the final wave of Xbox Game Pass releases for October 2026 and include a day-one catalog addition in the form of horror parkour game Terrible Lizards .
Terrible Lizards is the debut game from North Carolina-based WDR Studios, founded by the team behind nerdcore music channel JT Music, with Digital Pajamas and Dead by Daylight developer Behaviour Interactive publishing. The first-person horror platformer sends players through the abandoned Route 66 attraction Dalton's Dinos, where they must use parkour moves such as running, climbing, sliding, and wall-running to evade monstrous dinosaurs rather than fight them. The project first surfaced as a curated pick from the August 2025 PAX Rising Showcase before its formal reveal in March 2026. It locked down a release date on August 26, which is also when it was quietly confirmed for Xbox Game Pass .
Terrible Lizards, Mouthwashing, and More Now Available on Xbox Game Pass
An Appropriately Spooky Catalog Update Ahead of Halloween
Plants vs. Zombies: Replanted key art with the game's logo.
Image via Game Rant; Source: Square Enix
Aside from Terrible Lizards , the October 29 Xbox Game Pass batch consists of Final Fantasy 7 Remake Intergrade and Mouthwashing , plus Plants vs. Zombies: Replanted . The update, on the whole, has a fitting Halloween slant, with Square Enix's big-budget RPG being the only non-horror and non-horror-adjacent title. Plants vs. Zombies: Replanted isn't a day-one game, but it's not available on XGP Premium because it requires the EA Play add-on.
With these four games added, Xbox Game Pass has gained 17 new titles over the course of October 2026, five more than in September. That total excludes Keeper and Sandustry , both of which also expanded to the XGP Premium catalog this month.

Looking ahead, Microsoft's next content drop is scheduled for November 2, when day-one co-op "action builder" Gravhounds launches on Xbox Game Pass . Co-op horror game Pit of Goblin will follow on November 3, when Microsoft is also expected to announce the month's full Wave 1 lineup.
Bullet hell roguelite Void/Breaker will then reach version 1.0 on November 4. The update may also bring it to Xbox Game Pass Standard, following its August 2025 launch on PC Game Pass and Xbox Game Pass Ultimate .
